meaning: Deletes queued objects and frames, frees strata nodes, removes cursor and input registrations

name: CSimpleTop::DoNothing

name: CSimpleTop::RegisterFrame
meaning: Links a frame into the top's frame list at +0xcc0 through its +0x304 link

name: CSimpleTop::UnregisterFrame
meaning: Takes a frame out of its level and unlinks it from the top's frame list

name: CSimpleTop::ShowFrame
meaning: Puts a visible frame into its stratum's level node, creating nodes, and enters its input kinds

name: CSimpleTop::HideFrame
meaning: Takes a frame out of its level node and input lists, ending its move unless kept

name: CSimpleTop::NotifyFrameMoved
meaning: Marks a frame's stratum levels dirty, raises the frame being moved or sized unchecked and asks for a hover pick

name: CSimpleTop::NotifyFrameLayerChanged
meaning: Marks one draw layer of a frame's level node and its stratum's draw flag dirty

name: CSimpleTop::RegisterForEvent

name: CSimpleTop::UnregisterForEvent

name: LinkDeletionNode
